raw_text: Fake AI image of Modi-Xi handshake at G20 goes viral on WhatsApp. An AI-generated image purporting to show Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping in a warm handshake during the G20 Delhi Summit has gone viral on WhatsApp and social media. Multiple fact-checking organisations including Boom Live and Vishvas News have confirmed the image is artificial. The image contains tell-tale signs of AI generation including incorrect finger counts, absent EXIF metadata, and a background that does not match the actual G20 venue. Neither the PMO nor Chinese state media ever released such a photograph. The incident highlights growing concerns about AI-generated political imagery ahead of the 2024 elections.
